---
title: "ACS 1-year work-from-home data build"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: false
params:
  first_year: 2015
  baseline_year: 2019
  force_refresh: false
---

Builds the data behind the map in `docs/`. Each run checks the Census API for ACS 1-year releases not yet cached in `data-raw/`, pulls only those, then rebuilds every export from the cache. Set `CENSUS_API_KEY` in the environment first.

## STEP 0: Setup

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(sf)
library(tidycensus)
library(tigris)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

root <- normalizePath(".")   # render with knit_root_dir = repo root (see README)
source(file.path(root, "R", "functions.R"))

raw_dir  <- file.path(root, "data-raw")              # per-year cache, committed
out_dir  <- file.path(root, "docs", "data")          # served by GitHub Pages
dir.create(raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "geo"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

census_api_key(Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY"))
levels_to_pull <- level_catalog$id
```

## STEP 1: Which years are available and not yet cached

```{r years}
cached <- list.files(raw_dir, "^acs1_\\d{4}\\.csv\\.gz$") %>% str_extract("\\d{4}") %>% as.integer()
if (params$force_refresh) cached <- integer(0)

candidates <- setdiff(params$first_year:as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")), c(cached, 2020))
new_years  <- keep(candidates, acs1_available)
years      <- sort(c(cached, new_years))

tibble(cached = paste(sort(cached), collapse = " "),
       new    = paste(new_years, collapse = " "))
```

## STEP 2: Pull new years

```{r fetch}
# One call to load_variables() per year, then all WFH variables per level
for (y in new_years) {
  message("Fetching ", y)
  vars <- load_variables(y, "acs1", cache = TRUE) %>% parse_wfh_vars() %>% mutate(year = y)
  raw  <- map_dfr(levels_to_pull, fetch_level, vars = vars$name, year = y)

  write_csv(vars, file.path(raw_dir, sprintf("vars_%d.csv", y)))
  write_csv(raw,  file.path(raw_dir, sprintf("acs1_%d.csv.gz", y)))
}
```

## STEP 3: WFH shares and MOEs

```{r shares}
wfh_vars <- map_dfr(years, ~ read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, sprintf("vars_%d.csv", .x)),
                                      col_types = cols(year = "i", var_num = "i", .default = "c")))
raw <- map_dfr(years, ~ read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, sprintf("acs1_%d.csv.gz", .x)),
                                 col_types = cols(year = "i", estimate = "d", moe = "d", .default = "c")))

shares <- build_shares(raw, wfh_vars)

# Group order and labels follow the latest year; race follows the catalog order
latest <- max(years)
groups <- wfh_vars %>%
  filter(year == latest, role == "workers") %>%
  left_join(table_catalog %>% transmute(table, tbl_order = row_number()), by = "table") %>%
  arrange(dim, tbl_order, var_num) %>%
  distinct(dim, group_key, group_label)

# Groups missing from some years (label changes) show as gaps; list them here
wfh_vars %>% distinct(dim, group_key, year) %>% count(dim, group_key) %>%
  filter(n < length(years)) %>% rename(years_present = n)

# Sanity check: national WFH share by year (expect ~5% pre-2020, ~13-18% after)
shares %>% filter(level == "us", dim == "all") %>%
  select(year, workers = estimate_workers, wfh = estimate_wfh, share, share_moe)
```

## STEP 4: Export JSON and boundaries for the site

```{r export}
# Data: one file per level x dimension
for (lvl in levels_to_pull) for (d in dim_catalog$id) {
  g <- groups$group_key[groups$dim == d]
  write_dim_file(shares, lvl, d, g, years, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("wfh_%s_%s.json", lvl, d)))
}

# Region names (and place points)
place_pts <- fetch_place_points(years)
for (lvl in setdiff(levels_to_pull, "us")) {
  idx <- geo_index(raw, lvl)
  if (lvl == "place") idx <- left_join(idx, place_pts, by = "id")
  write_json(idx, file.path(out_dir, "geo", sprintf("%s_index.json", lvl)), digits = 5)
}

# Boundaries (newest vintage available)
st <- fetch_shapes(states, years, resolution = "20m")
write_geojson(st$shp, file.path(out_dir, "geo", "state.geojson"))
cb <- fetch_shapes(core_based_statistical_areas, years, resolution = "20m")
write_geojson(filter(cb$shp, LSAD == "M1"), file.path(out_dir, "geo", "metro.geojson"))

# Manifest the site reads first
manifest <- list(
  built         = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC", tz = "UTC"),
  years         = I(years),
  baseline_year = params$baseline_year,
  latest_year   = latest,
  boundary_year = st$year,
  levels        = level_catalog %>% select(id, label),
  dims          = dim_catalog %>%
    mutate(groups = map(id, ~ groups %>% filter(dim == .x) %>% select(key = group_key, label = group_label)))
)
write_json(manifest, file.path(out_dir, "manifest.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)

list.files(out_dir, recursive = TRUE) %>% tibble(file = .) %>%
  mutate(kb = round(file.size(file.path(out_dir, file)) / 1024))
```
